name: Restore Image
description: Makes an image bigger and sharper with SeedVR2, which redraws the detail a plain resize cannot: the image is resized by the factor (lanczos), restored in one diffusion step with tiled encoding and decoding, and its colors are put back from the resized input. Good after a generator, on blurred or low-resolution photos. A 7B model needs about 8 GB for itself, and more for a big result.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: SeedVR2 model
inputs.description: A SeedVR2 3B or 7B checkpoint with its stored embeddings: the Comfy-Org INT8 ConvRot files (seedvr2_7b_int8_convrot, seedvr2_3b_int8_convrot). Other repackagings (GGUF, the numz fp8) do not carry the embeddings and do not load.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.label: SeedVR2 VAE
inputs.description: ema_vae_fp16, the VAE both SeedVR2 sizes use.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.label: Factor
inputs.description: How many times bigger each side becomes. The result's pixels grow with its square: a 4098 x 4098 result fits a 24 GB card with the 7B model.

inputs.name: color_fix
inputs.label: Color fix
inputs.description: lab: the input's low frequencies and colors on the restored detail (a and b matched in CIELAB, lightness a fifth of the way). wavelet: only the low frequencies. none: the model's colors.

inputs.name: tile
inputs.label: Tile size
inputs.description: Pixels per side of the pieces the VAE encodes and decodes in (they overlap and are blended). Smaller uses less memory and is slower.

inputs.name: overlap
inputs.label: Tile overlap
inputs.description: Pixels two neighbouring tiles share, at most half the tile.
